name: Bundey BESS and Solar Project

scheme_contracts.execution_notes: Stage 1 of 1,200 MW / 3,900 MWh envelope. SA Dev Approval for solar Oct 2025 (concurrent with CIS). Comprehensive approval targeted Q1-Q2 2026; connections agreement Q2 2026. Pre-FID at ~10 months.

eis_specs.document_title: Bundey Bess And Solar Project — other source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.notes: Solar 900 MWac. BESS 1200 MW / 3900 MWh (3.25h duration). Regime: other. Genaspi Energy Group. 900 MW solar + 1200 MW/3900 MWh BESS (Stage 1: 300 MW/1200 MWh). ~12 km NE of Robertstown SA. SA Crown Sponsorship exemption gazetted 4 April 2024 (planning exemption for BESS). Selected for CIS Tender 4 (Oct 2025). Connection via ElectraNet PEC (Project EnergyConnect) at Bundey substation. Construction Q4 2026.

operational_notes: Stage 1 of full 1,200 MW / 3,900 MWh envelope. CIS T4 award covers 240 MW solar + 1,200 MWh Stage-1 BESS. SA Dev Approval for solar Oct 2025 (concurrent with CIS award). Comprehensive project approval targeted Q1-Q2 2026; Stage-1 connections agreement Q2 2026. Pre-FID at ~10 months post-award.
